title: The Shaking of the Heavens and the Earth
lead: The LORD's "shaking" of the heavens, the earth and the nations is a prophetic image of his coming, used by Haggai twice and quoted in Hebrews 12:26-27.

sections.b: At Sinai the whole mountain shook (Exodus 19:18; Judges 5:4-5). The prophets use it of the day of the LORD (Isaiah 13:13; Joel 3:16). Haggai announces a last shaking of heaven, earth, sea and dry ground and of all the nations (Haggai 2:6-7), then repeats it for the thrones of the nations (Haggai 2:21-22). Hebrews 12:26-27 quotes the Greek of Haggai and reads "once more" as the removal of what can be shaken so that what cannot be shaken stays.
